newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima shares hit year's low.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima shares hit year's low.

text.p: Shares in Tobishima Corp hit their lowest level for this year on Tuesday morning, dragged down by the firm's huge debts.
The share price of the general contractor slipped 15 yen to 355 yen by 0113 GMT, falling below its previous low for this year at 364 yen. Volume was 156,000 shares.
Investors are rebalancing their portfolios by selling some stocks, including those of Tobishima, and picking up blue-chip issues which are backed by solid corporate earnings, brokers said.
Tobishima said last month that it had drawn up a new restructuring plan to try to solve its financial difficulties, which were caused by heavy debts.
This month, Fuji Bank Ltd said it would give its full support to the struggling general contractor's reconstruction plans.
